points.title: 贵族出身
points.description: 保罗·路德维希·汉斯·安东·冯·兴登堡出生于普鲁士王国波兹南省的一个贵族家庭。他的父亲是普鲁士军官，家族有着悠久的军事传统。兴登堡接受了良好的贵族教育，后进入普鲁士著名的军事院校学习，为日后的军事生涯奠定了基础。这段贵族教育塑造了他强烈的爱国主义精神和保守主义世界观，影响了他后来的政治决策。
points.descriptionEn: Paul Ludwig Hans Anton von Hindenburg was born in Posen, Prussia (now Poznan, Poland) to a noble family with a long military tradition. His father was a Prussian officer, and Hindenburg received an excellent aristocratic education. He attended prestigious Prussian military academies, which laid the foundation for his future military career. This aristocratic upbringing shaped his strong patriotic spirit and conservative worldview, which influenced his later political decisions.

points.title: 一战东线统帅
points.description: 第一次世界大战爆发后，67岁的兴登堡被重新召回军队，担任东线第八集团军司令。他与埃里希·鲁登道夫将军合作，在1914-1915年的坦能堡战役中取得决定性胜利，击败了俄国第二集团军。这一胜利使兴登堡成为德国的民族英雄，1916年被任命为德军总参谋长，实际上成为德国军队的最高指挥官。他在东线的成功奠定了他在德国军政界的崇高地位。
points.descriptionEn: At the outbreak of World War I, the 67-year-old Hindenburg was recalled to service as commander of the German Eighth Army on the Eastern Front. In collaboration with General Erich Ludendorff, he achieved a decisive victory in the Battle of Tannenberg (1914-1915), defeating the Russian Second Army. This victory made Hindenburg a national hero in Germany, and in 1916 he was appointed Chief of the German General Staff, effectively becoming the supreme commander of the German military. His success on the Eastern Front solidified his prestigious position in German military and political circles.

points.title: 魏玛共和国总统
points.description: 1925年，兴登堡当选为魏玛共和国第二任总统，当时已78岁高龄。作为保守派代表，他对民主制度持怀疑态度。在任期间，他多次利用宪法第48条紧急状态权力，绕过议会直接颁布法令，削弱了民主制度的基础。1929年，他再次当选总统，但政治影响力逐渐下降。这一时期，他与社民党等民主力量保持距离，同时与保守派和民族主义者关系密切，为后来的政治危机埋下伏笔。
points.descriptionEn: In 1925, at the age of 78, Hindenburg was elected as the second President of the Weimar Republic. As a representative of conservative forces, he held skeptical views toward the democratic system. During his presidency, he frequently used Article 48 emergency powers to issue decrees without parliamentary approval, undermining the foundations of democracy. He was re-elected in 1929, but his political influence gradually declined. During this period, he maintained distance from democratic forces like the Social Democrats while building closer ties with conservatives and nationalists, laying the groundwork for future political crises.

points.title: 任命希特勒
points.description: 1933年1月30日，在政治危机和保守派压力下，兴登堡任命阿道夫·希特勒为德国总理。这一决定被认为是魏玛共和国终结的关键转折点。兴登堡错误地认为可以将希特勒置于控制之下，并利用纳粹运动来维护保守利益。然而，这一任命实际上为希特勒建立独裁统治铺平了道路。同年3月，兴登堡签署《授权法》，赋予希特勒独裁权力，彻底终结了德国的民主制度。兴登堡晚年对希特勒的妥协被视为他政治生涯中最大的失误。
points.descriptionEn: On January 30, 1933, under political crisis and pressure from conservative forces, Hindenburg appointed Adolf Hitler as German Chancellor. This decision is considered a key turning point in the end of the Weimar Republic. Hindenburg mistakenly believed he could control Hitler and utilize the Nazi movement to protect conservative interests. However, this appointment actually paved the way for Hitler's dictatorship. In March of the same year, Hindenburg signed the Enabling Act, granting Hitler dictatorial powers and completely ending Germany's democratic system. Hindenburg's late-life compromises with Hitler are regarded as the greatest mistake of his political career.

points.title: 逝世与遗产
points.description: 1934年8月2日，兴登堡在普伦湖畔的庄园去世，享年86岁。他的去世为希特勒彻底清除军队中反对势力提供了机会，希特勒随即宣布将总统与总理职位合并，自称为元首。兴登堡的葬礼成为纳粹宣传的工具，他的形象被希特勒政权利用。尽管兴登堡生前对纳粹持保留态度，但他的政治遗产却与纳粹德国紧密相连，成为德国历史上一个充满争议的人物。他的名字与兴登堡号飞艇灾难一起，成为20世纪德国历史的象征。
points.descriptionEn: On August 2, 1934, Hindenburg died at his estate near Lake Plön at the age of 86. His death provided Hitler with the opportunity to eliminate opposition within the military, and Hitler subsequently merged the positions of President and Chancellor, declaring himself Führer. Hindenburg's funeral was used as a propaganda tool by the Nazi regime, and his image was exploited by Hitler's government. Although Hindenburg had reservations about the Nazis during his lifetime, his political legacy became closely associated with Nazi Germany, making him a controversial figure in German history. His name, along with the Hindenburg disaster, became a symbol of 20th-century German history.

supporter.zh: 支持者将兴登堡视为德国爱国主义的象征和民族英雄。他们强调他在第一次世界大战中的军事成就，特别是坦能堡战役的决定性胜利，认为这些胜利挽救了德国免于早期战败。作为魏玛共和国总统，支持者认为他维护了国家稳定，在政治动荡时期提供了领导力。他的保守价值观和对传统的尊重被视为德国社会稳定的基石。
supporter.en: Supporters view Hindenburg as a symbol of German patriotism and a national hero. They emphasize his military achievements in World War I, particularly the decisive victory at Tannenberg, which they believe saved Germany from early defeat. As President of the Weimar Republic, supporters argue that he maintained national stability and provided leadership during a period of political turmoil. His conservative values and respect for tradition are seen as cornerstones of German social stability.

critic.zh: 批评者认为兴登堡是魏玛共和国民主制度的破坏者。他们批评他频繁使用紧急状态权力绕过议会，削弱了民主基础。最严重的批评是他1933年任命希特勒为总理的决定，这被视为对德国民主的致命打击。批评者指出，兴登堡的保守主义和贵族偏见使他无法适应现代民主政治，他的决策直接导致了纳粹独裁的建立，给德国和世界带来灾难性后果。
critic.en: Critics view Hindenburg as a destroyer of the Weimar Republic's democratic system. They criticize his frequent use of emergency powers to bypass the Reichstag, undermining democratic foundations. The most severe criticism is his decision to appoint Hitler as Chancellor in 1933, seen as a fatal blow to German democracy. Critics argue that Hindenburg's conservatism and aristocratic bias prevented him from adapting to modern democratic politics, and his decisions directly led to the establishment of Nazi dictatorship, bringing catastrophic consequences for Germany and the world.

objective.zh: 客观历史视角下，兴登堡是一位复杂的过渡性人物，代表了传统权威与现代民主之间的冲突。他既是德意志帝国军事传统的最后代表，又是魏玛共和国的象征性首脑。历史学界普遍认为，他的个人品质（如勇气和忠诚）与政治判断力之间存在明显差距。在流行文化中，兴登堡常被描绘为一位悲剧性人物，其保守主义价值观与时代变革之间的不适应最终导致了历史性错误。他的名字与兴登堡号飞艇灾难一起，成为20世纪德国历史的双重象征。
objective.en: From an objective historical perspective, Hindenburg was a complex transitional figure representing the conflict between traditional authority and modern democracy. He was both the last embodiment of Imperial German military tradition and the symbolic head of the Weimar Republic. Historians generally agree that there was a clear disparity between his personal qualities (such as courage and loyalty) and his political judgment. In popular culture, Hindenburg is often portrayed as a tragic figure whose conservative values were ill-suited to the changing times, ultimately leading to historical errors. His name, along with the Hindenburg disaster, has become a dual symbol of 20th-century German history.

self.zh: 我将尽我所能，为德意志民族的利益服务。
self.en: I will do my utmost to serve the interests of the German people.

others.zh: 兴登堡是一位伟大的将军，但作为政治家，他完全不适合担任国家元首。
others.en: Hindenburg was a great general, but as a statesman, he was completely unsuitable for the office of head of state.
